title: Nutty Portuguese Saskatoon Berry Tart
description: A buttery and crispy Portuguese tart featuring Saskatoon berries and tempering chocolate, perfect for a low-carb friendly dessert. This festive dish is sure to impress your guests.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond flour and granulated sweetener.
Add the melted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Arrange the Saskatoon berries on top of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Drizzle the melted chocolate over the Saskatoon berries.
Sprinkle the chopped walnuts over the top of the tart, if using.
Bake the tart for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
